summary: FFLA's New York list records a platform tower at Island Pond Mountain that is now gone; no other source found describes a structure there.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists Island Pond Mountain as a platform tower, status gone
evidence.quote: Island Pond Mountain Orange 41.26194 -74.13033 Platform Tower Gone

evidence.supports: FFLA files the entry under sites and non-lookout structures

notes_for_editor: No story written. The FFLA list is the only source found. A search for a tower on Island Pond Mountain returned only Harriman hiking pages and the separate Jackie Jones tower; none mentions a structure on Island Pond Mountain. Access and history are unknown.
